title: Page frame — colour themes
question: Page frame kept with a shorter foot row (keys smaller than the favorites rail). The layout stops changing now — these are colour-theme options: which teletext palette carries the chrome. Pick one (or steer).

options.label: Frame · Yellow index
options.lineage: the classic Ceefax index palette — black page, yellow page-numbers
options.thesis: The page you've been choosing: black ground, yellow as the index colour, white micro text, saturated floor rail.
options.viewport: Black page; 90px yellow clock, yellow P100 and P110 cues; micro lines grey-white; six saturated blocks on the floor; tiny grey-yellow chips at the foot.
options.risk: The default — safest, but yellow-on-black is what every teletext homage ships.

options.label: Frame · White page
options.lineage: inverted teletext pages (white-on-black flipped — used for special pages)
options.thesis: The inverted page: light ground, black index type — teletext's own negative, wallpaper window becomes a bright field.
options.viewport: Off-white page; black clock and indices; blue P110 cue; the six saturated floor blocks sit hard against the light ground; dark chips at the foot.
options.risk: A bright full-height ground at 85 inches glows like a lamp at night viewing.

options.label: Frame · Blue page
options.lineage: the Ceefax header blue promoted to a full page ground
options.thesis: Header blue everywhere: the whole page is the banner, yellow and white float on deep blue.
options.viewport: Deep blue page ground; yellow clock and cues; white micro lines; the six floor blocks sit on blue with white outlines; yellow chips at the foot.
options.risk: A saturated blue field across an OLED at 3 m is the most tiring of the four.

options.label: Frame · ORF cyan
options.lineage: ORF-Teletext style — cyan and magenta index colours on black
options.thesis: The alpine variant: cyan index type, magenta accents — same grid, cooler electricity.
options.viewport: Black page; cyan clock and cues; magenta P100 label; white micro lines; saturated floor rail unchanged; cyan chips at the foot.
options.risk: Cyan/magenta is niche — reads modern to you, obscure to anyone else.
